name: navigator-branch-grant-reconciled
body:
Reconciliation record (spec-writer) for `worktree-write-scope/feedback-13`.

Source statement (finding, treated as untrusted then confirmed): `requirements.requirement.navigator-no-unguarded-main-git` forbids any navigator git grant that changes main's branch state, yet explicitly KEEPs read-only `git branch *`; but `git branch *` also permits `git branch -f main <sha>`, `git branch -D`, and `git branch -m`, which rewrite branch refs and bypass the verify gate as surely as `git merge`.

Verified against the code graph + template: `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` → `implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`; its frontmatter `bash:` block lines 71-76 grants `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *`, `git branch *`, `git worktree list *`, `git rebase *`. The blanket `git branch *` is the sole non-read-only pattern in that set — the finding is correct.

Resolution [autonomous]: the requirement is rewritten so its required grant set and acceptance criteria name the read-only branch pattern exactly — the blanket `git branch *` is replaced by the exact pattern `git branch --show-current` (prints the checked-out branch; takes no ref-writing option). Branch listing is deliberately not granted (unnecessary — the branch/worktree identity comes from `apg project start`'s printed path and `git status`). The rest of the required set is unchanged: no `git merge`/`git checkout`/`git switch`; `git worktree *` narrowed to `git worktree list *`; `git rebase *` kept but only inside the project worktree; `git status *`/`git diff *`/`git log *` kept. The attaches-to constraint `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only` is amended to enumerate the forbidden branch-ref rewrites and the exact grant set, and `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`'s grant description is amended to match. Spine unchanged: `requirements.user.navigator-agent` ⊃ requirement —drives→ `domain.entity.main-integration` —realised-by→ `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (and `solution.component.worktree-isolation-guide`) —implemented-by→ the template file + `AGENTS.md`.

Code follow-up (separate plan task): `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` line 74 `"git branch *": allow` must become `"git branch --show-current": allow`, and the `AGENTS.md` "Worktree isolation" prose that lists the navigator's read-only git verbs must drop the blanket branch form. Out of scope for this finding but surfaced: `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` lines 38-39 grant the same blanket `git branch *` plus `git remote *` (also ref/config-mutating), and `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow` / `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` / `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` call them "the read-only git patterns" — the same class of defect for the agent-builder, not covered by feedback-13; recommend a follow-up finding.
